Download `OpenNTFS-<version>-arm64.dmg` below. Open it and drag OpenNTFS to Applications.

- Requires an Apple silicon Mac and macOS 13 or later.
- English and Russian interface. File operations run inside OpenNTFS.
- Locally signed experimental build; Apple Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.
- The matching `.sha256` file lets you verify the download.
